_note: 120 m four-mast ketch concept, 20 m beam. Placeholder rig, houses and heights; see scripts/validate-sail-clearance.mjs. Mast stations are the 68 m section fractions (mizzen 21.0/68, main 39.9/68) with a jigger aft at 0.14 L and a fore at 0.80 L (placeholders). Heights are metres above waterline. Run with: npm run validate:sails -- layout/sail-clearance-120m-4mast.json The bridge sits aft, over the main house between the mizzen and main masts; a bridge in front of the fore mast conflicts with the jib sweep unless the jib foot is about 12 m or less. Heel results come from the stability block (1,487 t, GM 2.13 m); see scripts/validate-sail-clearance.mjs.

houses.name: Bridge, one deck above main, aft (between mizzen and main masts)

program_source: Bridge 192.8 + Commander / Lido 191.5 (excludes the 87.5 m2 aft lido, which is open) + Main / Master 332.9, from layout/decks-layout.json unique rooms. Tween accommodation is on its own deck and not counted here.

stability._note: Recommended: 1,487 t displacement, GM for an 11 s roll at 20 m beam (k = 0.4 B). Sail area is derived from the rig triangles, scaled by sail_area_scale to about 4,000 m2 (about 31 sail area to displacement^(2/3), a performance range). Centre of effort is at a third of the luff. Cf is the placeholder force coefficient from docs/archive/68m/hull-dynamics-first-pass.md. Draft at 1,487 t is about 1.8 m, so the 4.8 m keel-up target no longer applies.
